checks: Explicit fictional example stays a draft until save, links to the selected branch, and recalculates the affected scenario.
Missing inputs, division by zero, absent names, cycles and executable-looking formulas show errors rather than zero; discard restores saved values.
The standalone browser evaluator matches backend scenario values and error presence on arithmetic, rounding, missing inputs and division.
An external revision blocks stale analysis saves without losing inputs; explicit discard loads the other editor’s analysis and preserves tree edits.
A completed, branch-linked work item keeps blank owner/date and leaves the tree’s uncertain claim unchanged.
Brief wording stays literal; number edits update referenced values and mark the old brief stale without refreshing its basis. An explicit wording check records a fresh revision.
Referenced models and tree branches cannot be deleted until their analysis references are deliberately removed or relinked.
HTML and Markdown retain models, workplan and brief; offline calculations match, local edits export and never change the live session.
The printable brief preserves saved wording, and the workspace remains bounded and usable at phone width.
